Name: Airborne SAR Mensuration Data Extension Format
Description: The MENSR extension format provides the collection geometry parameters required by image mensuration programs; it is optional, but its use will allow more accurate mensuration.

ACFT_LOC.Name: Aircraft Location
ACFT_LOC.Description: This field indicates the aircraft position at the UTC of the patch.

ACFT_LOC_ACCY.Name: Aircraft Position Accuracy
ACFT_LOC_ACCY.Description: This field identifies the 90% probable circular error value. Unknown=000000 or 000.00.

ACFT_ALT.Name: Aircraft Altitude
ACFT_ALT.Description: This field identifies the aircraft altitude in feet above mean sea level (MSL) at the UTC of the patch.

RP_LOC.Name: Reference Point Location
RP_LOC.Description: This field identifies the airborne system collection reference point, which may be at or near the center of each patch.

RP_LOC_ACCY.Name: Reference Point Location Accuracy
RP_LOC_ACCY.Description: This field identifies the airborne system collection reference point location accuracy.

RP_ELV.Name: Reference Point Elevation
RP_ELV.Description: This field identifies the elevation of the reference point above mean sea level (MSL).

OF_PC_R.Name: Range Offset
OF_PC_R.Description: This field identifies the distance between the RP and the patch center. Positive values indicate the RP is closer than the than the patch center to the sensor. Default = 0.

OF_PC_A.Name: Azimuth Offset
OF_PC_A.Description: This field identifies the distance between the RP and the patch center. Positive values indicate the RP occurs behind (i.e., earlier) than the patch center. Default = 0.

COSGRZ.Name: Cosine of the Graze Angle
COSGRZ.Description: This field identifies the cosine of the angle between radar line of sight (from an antenna at mid collection array to the target location (RP) and a plane tangent to the geoid at RP.

RGCRP.Name: Estimated Slant Range
RGCRP.Description: This field identifies the estimated slant range in feet from the antenna at mid collection array to the RP.

RLMAP.Name: Map Imaging Side
RLMAP.Description: This field indicates whether the map was images from the right (R) side or the left (L) side of the aircraft.

RP_ROW.Name: Row Containing the RP
RP_ROW.Description: This field indicates the row containing the reference point.

RP_COL.Name: Column Containing the RP
RP_COL.Description: This field indicates the column containing the reference point.

C_R_NC.Name: Range Unit Vector, North
C_R_NC.Description: This field indicates the north range vector unit.

C_R_EC.Name: Range Unit Vector, East
C_R_EC.Description: This field indicates the east range vector unit.

C_R_DC.Name: Range Unit Vector, Down
C_R_DC.Description: This field indicates the down range vector unit.

C_AZ_NC.Name: Azimuth Unit Vector, North
C_AZ_NC.Description: This field indicates the north azimuth vector unit.

C_AZ_EC.Name: Azimuth Unit Vector, East
C_AZ_EC.Description: This field indicates the east azimuth vector unit.

C_AZ_DC.Name: Azimuth Unit Vector, Down
C_AZ_DC.Description: This field indicates the down azimuth vector unit.

C_AL_NC.Name: Altitude: North Component
C_AL_NC.Description: This field indicates the north comoponent of altitude.

C_AL_EC.Name: Altitude: East Component
C_AL_EC.Description: This field indicates the east comoponent of altitude.

C_AL_DC.Name: Altitude: Down Component
C_AL_DC.Description: This field indicates the down comoponent of altitude.

TOTAL_TILES_COLS.Name: Total Number of Tiles, Column Direction
TOTAL_TILES_COLS.Description: This field indicates the total number of tiles in imaging operation in the column direction.

TOTAL_TILES_ROWS.Name: Total Number of Tiles, Row Direction
TOTAL_TILES_ROWS.Description: This field indicates the total number of tiles in imaging operation in the row direction.
